featured_reviews.name: Anmol Sanyasi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We went to Flavors at Bay near Hotel Hira mainly because it was convenient for us. Unfortunately, the food was a big disappointment.

I understand that it’s a vegetarian restaurant and spices are an important part of Indian cooking, but spices should complement the meal — not completely overpower it. Everything we ordered tasted like it was just packed with masala and nothing else.

We ordered momos, and they were honestly the worst part of the meal. They didn’t taste like real momos at all. Instead of a proper filling, it felt like a dough ball stuffed with pure spices. The taste matched how it looked — just overwhelming masala with no balance. Coming from a Nepali background where we eat momos often, this was really disappointing.

The biryani was the same story. It was mostly spice with very little flavor or balance beyond that.

The service itself was good and the staff were polite. The location was convenient for us as well. However, the restaurant felt quite empty and overall the food experience was not good. Unfortunately, the heavy spices even gave us heartburn afterwards.

We really wanted to enjoy the meal, but it ended up being a very disappointing experience.

featured_reviews.name: Burjiz
featured_reviews.review_text:
5 Stars for the Food
1 Star for the Pricing

I generally try not to give low ratings to businesses and prefer to give them the benefit of the doubt whenever possible.

However, fairness in reviewing also means pointing out issues when they arise.

Amar Juice Centre has long been a popular spot opposite Girgaon Chowpatty for quick snacks and street-style dishes. I’ve visited here multiple times over the years and have generally enjoyed the food.

On this visit, I ordered the Dahi Puri, which as always was excellent. The flavours were well balanced, the puris were crisp, and the overall taste was exactly what one expects from a good Mumbai chaat spot. In terms of quality, taste, and preparation, the food easily deserves five stars.

However, the pricing is where the experience becomes difficult to justify. The last time I visited, around 2024, the Dahi Puri was roughly ₹90. On this visit it was priced around ₹180 before taxes. That represents nearly a 100% increase in a relatively short period of time.

While some increase due to inflation is understandable, such a steep jump in pricing over roughly a year or two feels excessive from the perspective of a regular customer. Inflation sits generally at 5% a year not 50% a year!!

So while the food and service remain very good, and pretty much exactly as it was 2 years ago, the pricing makes the overall value difficult to justify.

featured_reviews.name: Dhananjay Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an absolutely terrible experience at Juice Time. The customer service was beyond disappointing — the staff were rude, inattentive, and acted like they were doing me a favor by even acknowledging my order. There was zero professionalism and no basic courtesy.

The food was just as bad. What I received was poorly prepared, tasted awful, and honestly felt unhygienic. It’s shocking how low the quality was, especially considering how simple the menu is.

Definitely one of the worst experiences I’ve had. Never ordering from here again.

featured_reviews.name: The Wandering Veggie
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered Falafel Shawarma 🥙, Pasta pe Pasta and Firangi (Peru+Strawberry) Juice 🍹

The Falafel Shawarma  was lovely, hummus, pickled beetroot, other veggies, falafels, everything was perfect.

The Firangi juice had more peru(guava) taste than strawberry, but was fresh and not too sugary. Will definitely try other curious combos the next time.

Pasta pe Pasta was a combination of macaroni in cheesy sauce and speghetti in red sauce, taste was pretty good, the breads served with it were a little dry.

Staff was very nice and let us use the group seating area which could easily accommodate 9-10 people although we were just 2. The ambience is pretty good.

If you advance book through Zomato Gold Dining option and then pay through Zomato Gold, you get flat 15% off on total bill which is a steal deal.
